dedupe_keys.name: couverture spatiale des coefficients d exposition aux vents cycloniques

description: The Ministry of Ecological Transition publishes spatial coefficients of exposure to cyclonic winds for Guadeloupe and Martinique. The source explicitly states that the coefficients are needed to calculate peak dynamic pressure under Eurocode 1-4 and the resulting wind action on buildings. Coefficients are provided for heights of 6, 10, 15 and 20 metres. The description identifies computational fluid dynamics and model grids of 250 or 180 metres depending on the territory; it does not assign those resolutions to a particular territory in the fields reviewed here. Some areas lack coefficients because abrupt relief could not be represented adequately at the model grid scale. Experts defined these uncovered areas, and the listing points to alternative calculation guidance. The metadata lists a ZIP download archive with explanatory documents and an Open Licence. The specific supported role is building wind-load exposure assessment. Archive contents, coefficient accuracy and the linked technical documents have not been inspected.
